observations: Two black, rectangular power banks lying on a concrete floor.
The top unit has a large piece of yellowish tape covering the front surface.
The bottom unit has a visible black label on the side, but the text is illegible.
Both units have green and blue braided cables attached.
The units appear to be made of plastic with a matte finish.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are visible on either unit.

claims.evidence: The items appear to be used and taped, but their internal condition and capacity cannot be verified from a photo.

risks.risk: The capacity (mAh) and voltage are unknown, which determines the value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label on the side of the bottom unit showing the specifications.

risks.risk: The internal battery cells may be dead or significantly degraded.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit charging a phone or a multimeter reading the voltage.

risks.risk: The internal circuitry may be damaged or faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powering on and charging a device.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the label on the side of the bottom power bank.
Video of the power bank charging a mobile phone.
Photo of the ports on the back of the units.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
